prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 25 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1332; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a side-impact motor vehicle collision at an intersection with complaints of right knee pain, swelling, and reduced range of motion. Initial examination revealed effusion and medial joint line tenderness, with limited flexion and pain with weight bearing. Imaging was obtained to rule out fracture, and no acute bony injury was identified. A clinical impression of medial collateral ligament sprain with associated meniscal irritation was made.

Conservative management was initiated, including a structured physical therapy program focused on quadriceps strengthening, range of motion restoration, and gait training, combined with anti-inflammatory medication and activity modification. The patient completed 25 visits over the course of treatment. Progress was gradual, with pain decreasing and swelling resolving over time. Range of motion improved substantially, and the patient was able to return to ambulation without an assistive device and to most daily activities.

At the most recent evaluation, residual mild discomfort with prolonged stair use and deep squatting persisted. The patient was counseled on a home exercise program and advised to report any locking, instability, or worsening symptoms. Further follow-up will be arranged as clinically indicated.
